C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.IntentSummary: Guard the canonical vitest configuration against the Node >= 25 default-on experimental Web Storage global (conditional test.execArgv with `--no-experimental-webstorage`), pin a functional jsdom localStorage regression check, and add .nvmrc so the Node 22 reference runtime is mechanical, not tribal knowledge. Tooling compatibility only; the sidebar cold-start timeout stays out of scope per the owner.
C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.ExecutionPolicy: Single sequential pass; no dependency on other active bundles. Verification runs locally on Node 22 and on the Windows polygon (laptop-kari, Node 25) with no NODE_OPTIONS override.

Gate.Name: node22-local
Gate.Expect: new check green; full suite green (66-file class of failures absent by construction on Node 22)

Gate.Name: node25-polygon
Gate.Command: Windows polygon: npm test with no NODE_OPTIONS
Gate.Expect: localStorage-dependent files green without any env override; only the separately tracked sideBar/index.test.js cold-start timeout may remain red

T-001.Title: execArgv guard in the canonical vitest config

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: vitest.config.ts derives nodeMajor from process.versions.node and passes execArgv = [...process.execArgv, '--no-experimental-webstorage'] only on major >= 25; on Node 22 the flag is absent and inherited execArgv is preserved.

tests/renderer/localstorage-webstorage-compat.test.js (TEST/LOCALS contract) pins function-typed getItem/setItem/removeItem/clear/key plus a set/get/key/remove/clear/length roundtrip with marker BLOCK_LOCALSTORAGE_CONTRACT_OK; on Node 25 without the guard it fails with the pointed TypeError, with the guard it passes.

Verification.Command: Windows polygon: npx vitest run tests/renderer/localstorage-webstorage-compat.test.js --config <guard-off copy> (expect FAIL), then with the canonical config (expect PASS)

T-003.Title: Reference runtime pin and governance records

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .nvmrc pins the CI Node major (22); graph M-046 summary line, V-M-046 command + scenario-18, train item FIX-013 and bundle evidence.json are recorded; grace lint --assertions current reports zero errors.

Corner.name: Correctness
Corner.Expected: The guard keys strictly on the Node major version; no flag probing at runtime; process.execArgv inherited before the added flag so dev NODE_OPTIONS survive.

Corner.name: Portability
Corner.Expected: Node 22 (reference) never receives the flag; Node 25+ workers start with webstorage disabled; nothing platform-specific enters the config.

Corner.name: Contracts
Corner.Expected: vitest.config.ts change cited as C-FIX-013 in-file; new test carries FILE/VERSION/MODULE_CONTRACT/MODULE_MAP; M-046/V-M-046 stay the durable owners.

Corner.name: Verification
Corner.Expected: Negative control (guard-off config on Node 25) and positive runs on both runtimes recorded in evidence.json; canonical polygon run needs no NODE_OPTIONS.

Corner.name: Security
Corner.Expected: No secrets, no network, no new dependency; test writes only its own localStorage keys.

Corner.name: Performance
Corner.Expected: execArgv addition is a no-op flag; no measurable startup cost on Node 22.

Corner.name: Scope discipline
Corner.Expected: sidebar/index.test.js timeout untouched; no CI workflow edits; no product code.

Corner.name: Delivery
Corner.Expected: Train item FIX-013 records reported/owner-scope/repair/evidence; acceptance stays pending.

Review.Findings: Correctness: the flag is version-gated so the Node 22 reference runtime keeps byte-identical worker arguments (it accepts the flag since 22.4.0 but needs nothing — Web Storage is not default-on there).
